sonnet.problem: The card says Moses 'won't be crossing the Jordan with them, because he must die in this land.' Deuteronomy 4:22 gives the two facts side by side ('I will die in this land; I will not cross the Jordan'). It does not say one is the reason for the other, so the card adds a cause the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Reasons: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.

sonnet.problem: The story card says 'not every manslayer can go there.' That gives away the answer to the next choice card (card 4), which asks which kind of man could flee to the cities, namely the one who killed unintentionally.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The joke doesn't click. 'Clear as can be' has no clear target, since nothing about Moses naming the cities is shown to be clear. The labeled-jars image (all six jars labeled TOPPINGS, so the sprinkles are hard to find) doesn't share the core action of Moses naming three cities. A stranger would say 'huh?'
sonnet.rule: If a stranger would say "huh?", rewrite it.
